name: retrieval-golden-v1
description: Tiny curated gold set for the retriever. Each case is a query plus the point IDs a human marked relevant. relevant_ids are the semantic.Point IDs the store returns; this fixture uses readable IDs (doc-*) so the corpus the test upserts and the labels here line up by eye. EvalRetrieval scores the real store's search output against these labels.

cases.name: france-capital
cases.query: What is the capital of France?

cases.name: go-concurrency
cases.query: How do goroutines and channels work in Go?

cases.name: photosynthesis
cases.query: How do plants convert sunlight into energy?
